notes: The report refers to a separate statutory CSR report (Samfundsansvar 2025) but itself describes specific workforce and community activities, so coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. The share of the underrepresented gender in other management levels fell from 30% (2024) to 12% (2025) against a 30% target. Employee-elected board members are 0% underrepresented gender against a 33% target. These are noted as a contradiction with the stated gender-balance policy. The arena naming and handball sponsorships are described mainly as marketing exposure, with community support secondary. AML e-learning is compliance training and was excluded. UngBank's ties with educational institutions are customer acquisition, not education, and were excluded. Seminars and webinars are described as marketing and were excluded.
